description: Deterministic commit-message hygiene checker: conventional-commit format, vague-subject detection, subject-length limit, a same-message secret-pattern scan (AWS keys, private key headers, Slack/GitHub tokens, inline password=/secret= style credentials - checked against the message text only, never a diff), and an oversized-commit warning from caller-supplied insertions/deletions. POST one commit or a batch (max 200). Deterministic, no LLM, no network.

insertions.description: Lines added; with deletions, drives the large_commit check.

message.description: Full commit message: subject, blank line, body.

commits.description: Alternative: batch of up to 200 commits.

max_lines_changed.description: Default 500. Total insertions+deletions above this triggers a large_commit finding.

name: commit_hygiene
